prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic full-body editorial photograph in a high-ceilinged aerial-dance studio with pale sprung flooring, a suspended ivory silk, and translucent curtains glowing in raking late-morning sunlight. One unmistakably adult woman whose facial appearance and long, dark, softly waved hair draw only from the supplied appearance reference performs a controlled one-leg balance drill beside the hanging silk. She wears a fitted sleeveless dance top and matte deep-cobalt stirrup leggings: two fitted legging legs continue cleanly to the ankle hems; each ankle hem visibly transitions into a narrow garment-owned strap; each strap travels visibly beneath the arch of the foot; left and right stirrup loops remain structurally consistent and visible. The only textile crossing either foot is that slim under-arch band, with bare toes, insteps, heels, and side arches exposed; socks, footed tights, shoe straps, or leg warmers cannot substitute for the loops. Her supporting foot rises onto the ball with its heel lifted and side arch turned toward camera, while the free leg extends diagonally behind with its sole angled inward, keeping both hem-to-loop routes simultaneously traceable. Frame her head to toe in a vertical full-length composition, with torso, hips, thighs, knees, ankles, and both complete feet sharply readable. The silk hangs beside her outer arm and the curtains stay behind her, leaving every target garment and foot region unobstructed. Use a 50 mm natural-perspective camera at hip height and sufficient depth of field for her calm concentrated face and both foot loops. Let the same curtain-filtered sunlight model her face, real fabric response, skin texture, and fine hair movement. Treat the supplied portrait solely as appearance_reference for facial, hair, and general-appearance continuity of an original adult scene subject; biometric identity verification is outside the image claim.
